item.title: Regional target
item.question: How each region's sales compares with its prorated target
item.sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COALESCE(SUM(s.subtotal), 0) AS actual_sales, r.sales_target * (julianday({{end}}) - julianday({{start}})) / 365.0 AS target_sales FROM regions r LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.subtotal, CASE WHEN c.country = 'USA' AND c.city IN ('San Francisco','Los Angeles') THEN 'North America West' WHEN c.country IN ('USA','Canada') THEN 'North America East' WHEN c.country IN ('UK','Ireland','Sweden') THEN 'Northern Europe' WHEN c.country IN ('Germany','France','Switzerland') THEN 'Central Europe' WHEN c.country IN ('Singapore','Malaysia','Indonesia','Thailand') THEN 'Southeast Asia' WHEN c.country IN ('Japan','South Korea') THEN 'Northeast Asia' WHEN c.country IN ('Australia','New Zealand') THEN 'Oceania' WHEN c.country IN ('UAE','Saudi Arabia') THEN 'Middle East' END AS region_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= {{start}} AND o.order_date < {{end}} AND o.status NOT IN ('refunded','cancelled') AND {{filter:segment:c.segment}} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND {{filter:category:cat.name}}) GROUP BY o.id, o.subtotal, c.country, c.city) s ON s.region_name = r.name GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.sales_target ORDER BY r.name
